key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:10F12
name: parse_checksummed_command_lines
description: Reads incoming bytes into a line buffer and treats prefixed packets as checksummed commands, verifying the sum of the payload before acting on it. Valid packets of the two known command types either set a mode flag or send a response string; anything else is handled as a plain line and terminated with a carriage return.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:10F4C
name: process_serial_input_lines
description: Reads incoming bytes into lines, terminating each at a carriage return and ignoring line feeds. Lines that match the text prefix or a checksummed command packet are forwarded to the same command handling used for packets, and the reader repeats until no more input is available.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:10F62
name: send_conditional_status_packet
description: Checks two 16-bit status words and, when either equals two, sends a fixed two-byte command followed by a 38-byte buffer through the output routine. It does nothing when neither status word is set.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:10FA6
name: send_pointer_derived_packet
description: Builds a four-byte command packet with a fixed identifier and length, copies in the bytes at offsets one and three of the passed pointer, and sends the packet to the output routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:10FEA
name: send_fixed_command_packet
description: Places a fixed two-byte command with a length field on the stack and passes it to the output routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:1101E
name: send_fixed_word_clear_flag
description: Passes a constant four-byte word to the output routine and then clears a state flag in the working block.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:11040
name: fill_buffer_descending_counts
description: Writes successive values of a counter as single bytes into a destination buffer, advancing the pointer each time. The counter starts at the passed count and decreases to zero, so the buffer receives that many bytes.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:11054
name: advance_random_seed
description: Calls a system routine for a value, adds a fixed constant, and stores the sum as a 32-bit seed in the state block. It returns the upper 16 bits of the new seed with the sign bit cleared.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:11088
name: store_high_word_seed
description: Stores the upper 16 bits of the passed 32-bit value into the seed slot of the state block, overwriting the previous seed.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:1109A
name: convert_lowercase_to_uppercase
description: Returns the character unchanged unless it is a lowercase ASCII letter, in which case it is shifted down by 32 to give the uppercase letter.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:110B2
name: convert_uppercase_to_lowercase
description: Returns the character unchanged unless it is an uppercase ASCII letter, in which case it is shifted up by 32 to give the lowercase letter.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:110CA
name: clear_state_open_dos_library
description: Zeroes a block of about 34 KB of working state and saves the exec base pointer and the global library base. It optionally calls a library routine when a flag bit is set, then opens dos.library and branches on whether the open succeeded.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:1113C
name: stub_no_operation_routine
description: The routine body is only a return with no work performed, so it is an empty placeholder entry.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:11144
name: allocate_tagged_record_entry
description: Allocates a zero-filled record whose size is derived from a stored count, writes the text MANX into its first field as a tag, and sets up its links. Depending on a status word it either fills in a new entry or marks an existing one active, then passes the resulting record to a system routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:1127A
name: tokenize_quoted_command_line
description: Copies a command string into a newly allocated buffer and splits it into tokens at spaces, tabs and line breaks. Double-quoted sections are kept whole, with a doubled quote mark treated as an escaped quote, and a pointer array to each token is built with a null entry at the end.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:1127C
name: tokenize_quoted_command_line
description: Copies a command string into a newly allocated buffer and splits it into tokens at spaces, tabs and line breaks. Double-quoted sections are kept whole, with a doubled quote mark treated as an escaped quote, and a pointer array to each token is built with a null entry at the end.

name: copy_string_padded_fixed
description: Copies at most the given number of characters from a source string, stopping at its terminator, and zero-fills the rest of the destination buffer up to that length.

name: copy_string_padded_fixed
description: Copies at most the given number of characters from a source string, stopping at its terminator, and zero-fills the rest of the destination buffer up to that length.

name: move_memory_block_overlap_safe
description: Copies a block of bytes of the given length, working backwards when the destination lies after the source so that overlapping regions are not corrupted.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:1147A
name: append_string_bounded_length
description: Appends a source string to the end of a destination string, copying at most about 32 thousand characters and writing a terminator if the copy was cut short.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:11480
name: append_string_limited_count
description: Appends a source string to the end of a destination string, copying at most the given number of characters and writing a terminator if the copy is cut short.

name: compare_strings_bounded
description: Compares two strings character by character for up to about 32 thousand characters. It returns zero when they match, one when the first string is greater at the first difference, and minus one when it is smaller.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:114D4
name: copy_null_terminated_string
description: Copies a null-terminated source string into the destination, including its terminator, and returns the destination pointer.

name: multiply_low_32_bits
description: Multiplies two 32-bit register values using their 16-bit halves and returns the low 32 bits of the product together with the original second operand.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:11508
name: resolve_window_entry_from_icon
description: Opens icon.library through a library call, looks up a window-related entry by the referenced name, and stores two pointers from that entry into the caller's record. It then closes the library.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:115BA
name: read_timer_time_value
description: Reads the system time through timer device requests and combines the two time fields into one value. The result is returned and also stored through the optional pointer, and if the timer cannot be opened a library routine reports it.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:115BC
name: read_timer_time_value

description: Calls an unsigned helper on the magnitudes of the operands and negates the result when exactly one operand is negative. The value is returned together with the second operand.

description: Calls a helper routine and returns its result together with the second register operand unchanged, adding no logic of its own.

name: divide_unsigned_32bit
description: Divides an unsigned 32-bit dividend by an unsigned 32-bit divisor. It uses bit-by-bit long division when the divisor exceeds 16 bits and a direct 16-bit division otherwise, returning the quotient and remainder as a pair.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:116F4
name: divide_by_swapped_halves
description: Performs a 16-step bit-by-bit division of the first operand by the second operand with its 16-bit halves swapped, leaving the quotient and remainder in the registers. It has no return value.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:BattleChess:0:1171A
name: measure_null_terminated_length

name: call_optional_hook_then_helper
description: Calls an optional callback stored in the state block when one is set, and then calls a helper routine.

description: Calls a helper routine, then passes a stored pointer from the state block to a second helper and returns the saved stack value.

description: Repeats the boot block code at this address: it bumps the interrupt-disable nesting counter and, when a disk boot is indicated, copies a header and transfers control to it. Otherwise it searches for a resident module and adjusts the counter before returning.

name: build_resident_module_tag
description: Builds a resident module header in memory from a match word, match tag, end address, flags, version, type, priority, name, identifier string and init routine. It then passes the header to an exec routine at a fixed offset.

name: update_boot_block_checksum
description: On a qualifying disk request, copies the boot image into the request buffer when needed, recomputes the one's-complement checksum over its 256 longs and stores it in the second long. It then calls the previously saved handler.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:bootblock:0:02CA
name: chain_after_counter_check

name: verify_keyboard_handshake_sequence
description: Waits for the keyboard serial line to signal, pauses in a timed loop, and compares each received byte with an expected decoded value until the terminator byte arrives. It then writes the DMA control register to enable DMA and restores the nesting counter.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:bootblock:0:036A
name: enable_dma_end_critical_section
description: Writes the DMA control register with the DMA-enable bit set, then decrements the interrupt-disable nesting counter before returning the saved stack value.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a5]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a5].adf:bootblock:0:0388
name: advance_sequence_counter

name: set_word_to_minus_one
description: Stores the value minus one into the 16-bit word pointed to by the address register and then calls a helper routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:Icon.Library:0:0284
name: allocate_buffer_for_transfer
description: Allocates a buffer of the requested size, passes it to a transfer routine together with the file arguments, and frees the buffer again if the transfer fails. It returns the buffer, or zero when allocation or transfer fails.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:Icon.Library:5:0000
name: read_disk_object_header
description: Allocates an icon record, reads the 44-byte icon file header into a buffer and copies its fields into the record, linking it to its chained object when one exists. It releases the record and returns zero when the header read fails.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:Icon.Library:5:004E
name: copy_icon_header_fields
description: Copies the 44-byte icon header block and its individual fields from a source buffer into the icon record at fixed offsets, then links the record into its chained object when one exists.

name: stub_return_zero

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:Icon.Library:5:00AA
name: write_disk_object_header
description: Builds an icon file header in a buffer, storing the disk-object magic and version words followed by the fields of the icon record, and passes the buffer to a write routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:Icon.Library:5:0124
name: load_icon_info_file
description: Builds the icon file name by appending the .info suffix, opens it in old-file mode and reads the 78-byte disk-object header. It checks the magic and version words, reads the image and tool-type data into newly allocated memory, then closes the file.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:Icon.Library:5:0180
name: read_disk_object_from_stream
description: Reads a disk object from a stream through read and allocate callbacks, verifying its magic and version words. It then reads the optional image, drawer and tool-type sections into newly allocated memory and returns one on success or zero on any failure.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:Icon.Library:5:024C
name: read_icon_extra_sections
description: Reads the optional sections that follow the icon header through the same read and allocate callbacks, filling a pointer array entry by entry. It returns one when every section reads successfully and zero otherwise.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:Icon.Library:5:033A
name: read_icon_pointer_array
description: Fills an array of pointers from a stream, reading one value per entry through the read and fetch callbacks while the remaining byte count is above four. It then reads the optional trailing section and returns one on success.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:Icon.Library:5:03F2
name: call_helper_return_zero
description: Calls a helper routine and then returns zero, reporting no result.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:Icon.Library:5:03F6
name: stub_no_operation_routine
description: The routine body is only a return with no work performed, so it is an empty placeholder entry.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:Icon.Library:5:03FE
name: save_icon_info_file
description: Builds the icon file name with the .info suffix in a 260-byte buffer, creates the file in new-file mode, writes the 78-byte disk-object header and then the optional sections, and closes the file. It reports an error code when the file cannot be created.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:Icon.Library:5:0440
name: write_icon_sections_stream
description: Writes the optional icon sections that follow the header through a write callback, including the default tool string and the tool-type entries, and restores the saved field afterwards. It returns one on success and zero when any write fails.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:Icon.Library:5:04F6
name: write_icon_string_sections
description: Writes the default tool string, then the tool-types array entry by entry, then the tool window string, each prefixed with its length plus one through a write callback. It returns one when every write succeeds.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:Icon.Library:5:058A
name: write_tool_types_array
description: Totals the size of the tool-types array, writes that size, and then writes each entry through the write callback before writing the tool window string. It returns one when all writes succeed.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:Icon.Library:5:05B2
name: write_tool_type_strings
description: Writes each tool-type string prefixed with its length plus one through the write callbacks until the null terminator of the array, then writes the tool window string. It returns one when all writes succeed.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:Icon.Library:5:0666
name: release_icon_list_items
description: Repeatedly takes the next item from the list at the given offset and releases it until the list is empty.

name: call_helper_on_icon_substructure
description: Passes the icon record's embedded sub-structure at offset 140 to a helper, together with the caller's first argument.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:Icon.Library:5:06B2
name: allocate_disk_object_record
description: Allocates a zero-filled 168-byte record, reads its data through a read routine, and returns it when the read succeeds. Otherwise it frees the record and returns zero.
